text: Extirpation [Lat. extirpatio ]: Ger. Abtragung , Extirpation ; Fr. extirpation or avulsion (according to the case -- ( Y.D. )); Ital. estirpazione . The experimental removal of some part of an organ (as of the brain) for the purpose of ascertaining the nature of the changes in function resulting from its removal. Cf. LOCALIZATION (cerebral). ( H.H. )
